# Files in this folder are generated by pipeline scripts




bootstrapped permissions

eks-podidentity assoc were created in the control plane base pipeline for the following service accounts since the provider itself is the API that create the permission requirements. E.g., You can'at have crossplane provision an eks-pod-identity for the eks provider becuase the eks provider is required to create the association in the firt place.

* upbound-provider-family-aws
* upbound-provider-aws-iam
* upbound-provider-aws-eks
* upbound-provider-aws-kms
